_about: Sample content for your seed script. Each section is a grid of rows (A, B, C...) with seatsPerRow seats numbered from 1. An event's seat price is the section's basePriceCents times the event's priceMultiplier. soldRatio is the share of seats to mark sold so the seat map looks realistic. daysFromNow and hour are relative to when you run the seed, so events always land in the future.
